verdict.rationale: A third-party data marketplace is a fair question for a cloud data platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a marketplace or listings of third-party datasets that an analyst can browse and use to enrich their own data. The only related evidence is Secure Data Sharing, which shares selected objects between Snowflake accounts. That is an adjacent capability and does not establish a marketplace, so it earns no credit here.
